reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text:
Other than the direct bits from actual TV, movies & songs, these ringtones are pretty awful. Very low-quality versions of songs, sounds, etc. The original stuff is even worse. I wish there were more variety in the selection of songs (the ‘80s, but virtually no New Wave, Electronica, or Punk?); in the films (very few older classics & ‘80s
and ‘90s indie films); in TV, little of real interest. OK, you go for only the most popular stuff. Lots of us want COOL, unusual ringtones, not from the most obvious things out there!
